what_it_does: Presents ChipAlign, a technique to combine two types of large language models without retraining: models specialized for chip design instruction-following capability. Existing chip-specific models like ChipNeMo are trained on hardware data but don't follow user instructions well. ChipAlign merges weights along a geodesic (shortest path) through the model's mathematical weight space, producing a model that inherits both strong instruction-following behavior and deep chip domain expertise.
